signal: task or user request is available
action: copy exact goal and constraints into recovery note

signal: plan/spec has explicit tasks
meaning: planned scope is a hint not proof
action: map each checkbox to current evidence

signal: clean status after relevant commit
action: inspect commit files and rerun tests before resuming

signal: dirty source with matching failing test
action: read diff and failure before editing

signal: dirty file outside task
action: protect it and exclude from scope

signal: untracked generated output
action: identify source owner and whether artifact is tracked

signal: conflict markers in source
action: read both semantic sides before resolution

signal: test log predates current files
meaning: recorded result is not current proof
action: rerun relevant command and compare first failure

signal: implementation has no behavior proof
action: write lowest-level regression before changing more

signal: targeted test fails after partial patch
meaning: implementation is broken or fixture is wrong
action: classify failure and trace owning boundary
stop_condition: stop broad refactor until cause known

signal: generated file disagrees with source
action: identify generator then regenerate only owned output
evidence: source hash generator command and diff

signal: migration applied partially
meaning: rollback and data safety are uncertain
action: inspect migration status and backup before app edits

signal: imports or types broken after refactor
action: find first compiler/test error and map old callers

signal: new producer exists but caller still old
action: trace producer to all consumers and update contract tests
stop_condition: stop if public contract intent unclear

signal: shared code changed without native proof
action: inspect iOS Android or desktop diffs and run narrow platform check
stop_condition: stop release claim without target proof

signal: chat or agent context is missing
action: use durable files logs commits and fresh tests
evidence: task docs status diff and tests
stop_condition: stop if goal cannot be reconstructed

signal: previous agent changes have no attribution
action: preserve files and audit each changed boundary
evidence: diff timestamps tests and surrounding contracts

signal: fresh targeted and affected checks pass
action: record command output and move to next unmet dependency
stop_condition: stop only if all requirements mapped

signal: code appears complete but no fresh proof
meaning: implementation may be correct but cannot be claimed
action: run exact relevant verification before edit
stop_condition: stop completion claim until fresh run

signal: one dependency is clearly next
meaning: progress can resume without redoing work
action: perform smallest read/test action that proves boundary
stop_condition: stop when action requires user choice

signal: next action would delete/reset/migrate/overwrite
action: ask for explicit approval and preserve evidence

signal: recovery note has completed partial broken remaining
meaning: another engineer can resume without guessing
action: write evidence-backed handoff
stop_condition: stop once next safe action is executable
